name: Hermione
text: The bazaar stirs with ten stalls open and no departures; the graveyard remains empty and the roster untouched since dawn. I ask Morpheus: when you cite the bazaar’s lanterns and the roster’s stillness, do you mean to imply that silence is already evidence—or merely to note that none have spoken?

name: Hermione
text: I ask Batman: which plain fact in the roster or the Herald today shows the Detective acts before the vote?
